priority_items.title: RNZ wires Fiji HIV national emergency; gazette / Legal Notice still outstanding
priority_items.summary: In-window RNZ Pacific (16 Sep 11:20 NZST / 23:20 UTC 15 Sep) recaps the 15 Sep ministerial HIV emergency (Lalabalavu pre-recorded statement; Rabuka + Cabinet backing as reported). 1-in-60 adult prevalence; antenatal ~2%; needle-and-syringe + PrEP + long-acting injectable; proposed parliamentary standing committee. Partners named AUS/NZL/Global Fund/IND/UN. Not a new declaration — FBC/Mai TV/Fiji One already had it 15 Sep. fiji.gov.fj still has no s.69 PHA 1935 Legal Notice. RNZ “1 in 1667 five years ago” conflicts with FBC/Mai TV “1 in 167/165” — likely transcription error. Not FLASH.

priority_items.title: Matui legal track unchanged: arrest still requested not executed; VFSC still no Tui extract
priority_items.summary: No in-window arrest/charges story. Daily Post complaint piece remains the lead (Shipping Act s.42; Penal Code s.108 request; family-list 53 CLAIM).
